/* Tbm03Mapper.selectUserProgressList */ SELECT AT.USER_TYPE_CD AS userTypeCd , TP.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS userTypeNm , AT.USER_CD AS userCd , CASE WHEN AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' THEN RU.USER_ID ELSE DU.USER_ID END AS userId , CASE WHEN AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' THEN RU.USER_NM ELSE DU.USER_NM END AS userNm /* 고용형태: 정규직 EMPLOYMENT_TYPE(SYS041), 일용직은 'DAILY'/'일용직' 고정(D-8) */ , CASE WHEN AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' THEN RU.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE ELSE 'DAILY' END AS employmentTypeCd , CASE WHEN AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' THEN ET.SYST_VAL_D_NM ELSE '일용직' END AS employmentTypeNm /* 부서: 정규직만(일용직은 NODE_CD 없어 NULL → FE '-') */ , ND.NODE_NM AS deptNm /* 누적 교육시간(D-4): 이수 세션 EDU_MINUTES 합, NULL 0 처리 */ , IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' THEN IFNULL(S.EDU_MINUTES, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalEduMinutes /* 수료 세션수 */ , IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedSessionCount /* 미이수 세션수: 입실했으나 미완료(NULL or NOT_COMPLETED) */ , IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL AND (AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD IS NULL OR AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'NOT_COMPLETED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS notCompletedSessionCount /* 최근 이수일(D-5): 이수 출결의 STATUS_UPDATED_AT MAX(없으면 NULL) */ , DATE_FORMAT(MAX(CASE WHEN AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' THEN AT.STATUS_UPDATED_AT END), '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastCompletedAt FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( AT.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND S.STATUS_CD != 'CANCELLED' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER RU ON ( AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' AND AT.CMPNY_CD = RU.CMPNY_CD AND AT.USER_CD = RU.USER_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DAILY_USER DU ON ( AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'DAILY' AND AT.CMPNY_CD = DU.CMPNY_CD AND AT.USER_CD = DU.USER_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE_NODE ND ON ( AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' AND RU.CMPNY_CD = ND.CMPNY_CD AND RU.SITE_CD = ND.SITE_CD AND RU.NODE_CD = ND.NODE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS050' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) TP ON ( AT.USER_TYPE_CD = TP.SYST_VAL_D_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS041' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) ET ON ( RU.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE = ET.SYST_VAL_D_CD )
/* 사용자 1명 = 1행(D-2) */ GROUP BY AT.USER_TYPE_CD, AT.USER_CD /* 기본 정렬(D-6): 최근 이수일 DESC(NULL 마지막), 동률 시 이름 ASC */ ORDER BY lastCompletedAt IS NULL, lastCompletedAt DESC, userNm ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

/* Tbm03Mapper.selectUserProgressListCount */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( AT.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND S.STATUS_CD != 'CANCELLED' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER RU ON ( AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' AND AT.CMPNY_CD = RU.CMPNY_CD AND AT.USER_CD = RU.USER_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DAILY_USER DU ON ( AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'DAILY' AND AT.CMPNY_CD = DU.CMPNY_CD AND AT.USER_CD = DU.USER_CD )
GROUP BY AT.USER_TYPE_CD, AT.USER_CD ) T

/* Tbm03Mapper.selectUserProgressDetail */ SELECT AT.ATTENDANCE_CD AS attendanceCd , AT.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , S.TITLE AS sessionTitle , DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(S.ENDED_AT, S.INSERT_DATE), '%Y-%m-%d') AS sessionDate , S.EDU_MINUTES AS eduMinutes , DATE_FORMAT(AT.ENTRY_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS entryAt , DATE_FORMAT(AT.EXIT_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS exitAt , AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD AS completionStatusCd , CS.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS completionStatusNm FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( AT.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND S.STATUS_CD != 'CANCELLED' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS053' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) CS ON ( AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = CS.SYST_VAL_D_CD )
/* 이수일(STATUS_UPDATED_AT) 최신순, NULL 마지막 */ ORDER BY AT.STATUS_UPDATED_AT IS NULL, AT.STATUS_UPDATED_AT DESC, AT.ATTENDANCE_CD DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

/* Tbm03Mapper.selectUserProgressDetailCount */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( AT.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND S.STATUS_CD != 'CANCELLED' )

/* Tbm03Mapper.selectUserProgressSummary */ /* SUM은 행이 0건이면 NULL을 반환하므로 IFNULL로 0 보정(결과 record가 primitive int) */ SELECT /* 누적 교육시간(D-4): 이수 세션 EDU_MINUTES 합 */ IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' THEN IFNULL(S.EDU_MINUTES, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalEduMinutes , IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedCount , IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL AND (AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD IS NULL OR AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'NOT_COMPLETED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS notCompletedCount FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( AT.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND S.STATUS_CD != 'CANCELLED' )
